title: Zesty Vietnamese Pork Ti Leaf Wraps
description: A flavorful and savory Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring juicy pork, crispy ti leaf wraps, and a cheesy, buttery sauce. This crowd-pleaser is perfect for a weeknight dinner or brunch.

ingredients.name: Cheese strings
ingredients.notes: such as mozzarella or Monterey Jack

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Place the pork shoulder in a large ziplock bag and pour in the marinade. Seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
After marinating, remove the pork from the bag and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Broil for 15-20 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, toast the ti leaves by placing them on the baking sheet with the pork. They will turn crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the wraps, place a piece of crispy ti leaf on a flat surface, followed by a few slices of the cooked pork, a sprinkle of cheese strings, and a dollop of salted butter.
Fold the bottom of the ti leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining pork and ti leaves, and serve immediately.
